name: PA-02
label: Safe D

key_factors: Strong Democratic district with a +19 partisan lean
Incumbent Brendan Boyle running with large financial advantage ($5.6M cash)
Republican challenger Jessica Arriaga has minimal reported fundraising
Prediction markets price Democratic win at ~97%
model.rationale: Boyle is a well-funded incumbent in a district that leans Democratic by 19 points, with no outside spending against him and no polling suggesting vulnerability. Markets and fundamentals both point to an easy Democratic hold.
model.watch: A surprise scandal or major outside spending against Boyle would be the only realistic path to making this competitive.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Brendan Boyle seeks another term in a Philadelphia-area district that leans Democratic by 19 points. He has raised $2.45 million and holds $5.6 million on hand, while Republican challenger Jessica Arriaga shows no reported fundraising and draws no outside support. No independent groups are spending against Boyle, and no expert raters flag the race as competitive.

Prediction markets price a Boyle win at roughly 97 percent, consistent with the district's fundamentals. With no public polling and a challenger lacking visible resources, the race is rated Safe Democratic with high confidence.
